system.description:
Doubletalk is a trick passed among the Toreador for centuries. The character speaks a full sentence very quickly and softly, hidden between words spoken normally so that it sounds like a conversational placeholder ('uh,' 'er,' 'hmmm') to most listeners. Someone familiar with the power can pick out the hidden sentence; true masters can compress entire soliloquies into a single grunt. This is not an exclusive secret of the clan — some Tremere and Malkavians have also mastered the technique.

To listen for Doubletalk in a conversation, the player makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty five Traits); success means the character hears what was said, while failure means she heard nothing. To speak Doubletalk, the player makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty six Traits); success lets the character seamlessly insert the hidden phrase, while failure means she isn't understood. A single challenge suffices for an entire conversation. This power costs five Experience Traits to learn.
